title: QualificationEnrollment
description: docs/qualification/enrollment.json: the caller repositories whose shadow runs `faraday-review collect` archives. `visibility` is the operator's declaration only; collect re-reads it from the GitHub API and treats the repository as private unless both say public. A private repository's entry belongs in an enrollment file outside this public repository.

workflow.description: Caller workflow file that invokes shadow.yml.

enrolled_from.description: Optional. Only runs created on or after this date are collected.
